sloka: अनुज्ञातंस्तु रामेण तद्विमानमनुत्तमम् ।उत्पपात महामेघः श्वसनेनोद्धतो यथा ।। ६.१२६.१ ।।
transliteration: anujñātaṁstu rāmeṇa tadvimānamanuttamam ।utpapāta mahāmeghaḥ śvasanenoddhato yathā ।। 6.126.1 ।।

translations.english: Swan shaped Pushpak, unsurpassed in appearance like swan, making great sound started to fly with the permission of Rama.
